scope: Independent cross-author static driver/plan/evidence review. No build, test child, profile, timing, source/referee/Git change or new agent by this reviewer.
verified_guards: Correct old/new adapter include and implementation paths; shared target/referees; matching filename literals and flags
Both independent adapter A/A gates +/-1% and all windows>=10ms; comparison windows also>=10ms or conditional
One synchronous child/process group at a time; exclusive campaign lock and runner ACK
Child timeout min120s/remaining phase wall/remaining timed/global04:45UTC
Post-child and post-derive source/timed/wall/global checks before complete
Timeout/interruption/exit-race cleanup, partial logs and truthful reaped metadata
No retries/overwrites/count retuning; incomplete schedules preserved without partial effects
Matched root/independent PASS and published exact-freeze ACK required before measurements
initial_findings_resolved_before_measure: General BaseException/ProcessLookupError cleanup and accurate child-reaped state
ABBA owned-memory/construction-fingerprint checks and comparison minimum-window gate
Remaining timed-budget child clipping and unknown timed work on CSV failure
Absolute interpreter metadata curated; raw original journal preserved
limitations: PASS is for this exact harness diagnostic; it is not a tree optimization/acceptance/population.
Failed completed controls make the corresponding comparison conditional; incomplete controls prevent comparison.
Exclusive-runner/no-concurrent-agent conditions require root to enforce the ACK operationally.
No historical timing subtraction, no adapter pooling, no extrapolation beyond8contracts.
remaining_pre_run_step: Root publishes exact final freeze/reviews, issues matching authorization ACK, and confirms all other work idle.
